summary: Ryanair Holdings plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting that shareholders approved all nine resolutions at its 2026 AGM held on 10 September 2026. Support was substantial: financial statements and final dividend each drew 100%, director elections ranged 95%-100%, authority to allot shares 92%, disapplication of pre-emption rights 97%, and share repurchase authority 90%. The remuneration policy passed at only 61%, prompting management to state it will consult shareholders on that result. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; this is a routine meeting outcome, not a special situation.
